question: The Arjuna award started in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1961.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arjuna Award **was instituted in the year **1961** by the **Government of India** to recognize **outstanding achievement** in **sports.**
 
• The award is named after** Arjuna**, a famous character from the **Indian epic Mahabharata** who was a **skilled archer**.
 
• The award is given **annually **to Indian sportspersons who have made **remarkable achievements **in their respective fields.
 
• The** first recipient **of the Arjuna Award was **wrestler Gurbachan Singh Randhawa** in **1961.**
 
• Option 1 (1978) and Option 4 (1972) are** incorrect** as the Arjuna Award was instituted in 1961, and Option 2 (1970) is also **incorrect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 **(1978) is the year when the **Dhyan Chand Award** was instituted by the Government of India to recognize lifetime achievement in sports.
 
• **Option 2** (1970) and **Option 4 **(1972) **do not** have any significance in the context of the Arjuna Award.
 
• Hence, the **correct option** is Option 3 (1961).
